title: Citizenship for Male Permanent Residents who Complete National Service
what_it_is: Citizenship for Male Permanent Residents who Complete National Service

sections.label: Citizenship for PRs after NS
sections.summary: Singapore Citizenship is not automatic for Permanent Residents who completed National Service; they must apply and are assessed, with NS performance a plus factor.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Singapore Citizenship (SC) is not granted automatically to Permanent Residents (PRs) who have completed National Service (NS).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: PRs who are interested in taking up citizenship would have to apply and will be assessed accordingly.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The fact that the PR has completed National Service and has performed well during NS will be a plus factor in the evaluation.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For the period from 2011 to 2015, ICA received about 4,000 applications for citizenship from PRs who had completed full-time NS.
